definition: GCTS-I cold-start geometric failure marking, not policy learning

protocol.control: same complete lattice-point branching, oldest-frontier rule, balanced move order, and generation-lag cap; failure marking disabled
protocol.runtime_knowledge: Every GCTS run starts with an empty marking. No proposal patch, learned weights, tile identifier, periodic template, or previous-run state is supplied.
protocol.metric_note: effective_branch_throughput_ratio is (entered GCTS nodes + exact marking prunes) / entered control nodes under the same wall-clock budget. It measures search alternatives disposed of, not a direct wall-clock speedup.

selected_hyperparameters.blocker_certificate: first exact blocker per rejected candidate, then union

sweep_conclusions: A one-span support is sufficient: every placement that can block a candidate covering the marked point intersects that candidate's bounding box. Larger reaches made clauses less reusable and slower.
Collecting the first exact blocker preserved soundness and wall-clock depth; collecting every alternative blocker reduced clause size slightly but spent too much time constructing certificates.
The 24-rotation quotient found essentially the same recurrences but was slower than translation normalization on all four training cases. It remains available as a hyperparameter.
Context caps of five or six tiles discarded useful exact clauses on 10_16113 and 9_11683. Oversize contexts are therefore retained rather than truncated.
Immediate activation won. Because every stored clause is an exact obstruction, no statistical burn-in is required.

results.note: Each run learned one six-tile obstruction and reused it 521-524 times.
